title: Orchestrator and Workers in LangGraph
learning_objectives: Fan out work to parallel workers with Send
Collect worker results with a reducer and restore their order
Combine results in a synthesiser node
hints: `orchestrator` returns `{"sections": [s.strip() for s in state["document"].split("\n\n") if s.strip()]}`.
The fan-out function returns a list of `Send("worker", {...})`; register it with `add_conditional_edges("orchestrator", assign, ["worker"])`.
The worker receives the Send payload (with `index` and `section`), not the whole state.

failure_feedback.advice: Fan out with Send('worker', {'index': i, 'section': s}) and join results in synthesise.
Sort the collected (index, summary) pairs before joining.
Split on blank lines and drop empty sections.
Annotate results with operator.add so every worker's update is kept.
